title: Grass with a particle system
summary: The ground gets a hair particle system 'Cesped' that renders the 'Hierbas' collection (a random clump each), stood up with Advanced > Rotation (object axis), 1000 particles, a little random rotation and full random scale, and 20 interpolated children between particles (20000 clumps, still light to display).
expected_result: A dense lawn of grass clumps of different sizes covering the ground around the pipe, mushroom and bomb.

steps.note: Particle properties > New, 'cesped', type Hair; Render As Collection 'Hierbas'; Advanced > Rotation on, object Y: they stand up; 1000; randomize rotation a little and scale fully; Children > Interpolated, 20 in viewport and render
